head: bff016032978e2b3100b2fd7239aae723c7dd9af
subject: Dragging the bottom BUY/SELL total-order button onto a price lane does not submit a modification.
conclusion: Confirmed current implementation and existing test expectation: bottom totals are cancellation-only drag handles. A drop onto a price is ignored before any order API request is constructed. Both BUY and SELL reproduce.

code_evidence.finding: Total-order buttons call beginDrag with cancelOnly=true.
cancelOnly prevents assigning a target price even over a valid matching-side price lane.
Without an outside-cancel or target price, endDrag returns without request().

introduced_by.intent: Bottom totals support same-side drag-out cancellation and right-click per-order editing; they do not implement cross-price bulk modification.

checks.command: npx playwright test live-orders.spec.ts --grep '총 접수 버튼의 드래그 아웃|총 접수 우클릭 메뉴|같은 가격의 여러 주문' --reporter=line
checks.result: 5 passed (14.7s). For both sides, total-to-price drop emits zero commands, drag-out cancels matching orders, and per-order menu drags modify the selected order. Same-price grouped modification also passes.

environment.credentials: Existing Playwright blank vendor environment; empty worktree .env.

available_workaround: Right-click the bottom side total, then drag an individual order from the list to the desired same-side price lane.
scope: Investigation only. No product code, running user server, account setting or real order was modified. Order mutations in reproduction were intercepted by existing Playwright route fixtures.
limits: The reported individual user gesture was not captured; investigation targets the bottom direction-total buttons described by the user.
Actual exchange execution is not tested; the reproduced missing step is the price-modification request itself.
